rationale: The previous fix added get_queryset() but didn't address the IDOR vulnerability in the legacy document_id query parameter path. Line 232 still uses Document.objects.get(pk=obj_id) which retrieves documents without permission filtering. The fix changes this to use the filtered queryset (either passed in or obtained via get_queryset()) so that unauthorized document access attempts will raise DoesNotExist/404 instead of retrieving the object and then checking permissions. This prevents information disclosure about document existence.
patch:
--- a/wagtail/documents/views/documents.py
+++ b/wagtail/documents/views/documents.py
@@ -228,8 +228,12 @@ class EditView(generic.EditView):
 
     def get_object(self, queryset=None):
         obj_id = self.request.GET.get("document_id")
         if obj_id:
-            obj = Document.objects.get(pk=obj_id)
+            # Use the filtered queryset to ensure permission checks happen before retrieval
+            if queryset is None:
+                queryset = self.get_queryset()
+            obj = queryset.get(pk=obj_id)
         else:
             obj = super().get_object(queryset)
